title: The Short Sword Primer
summary: Teaches a complete beginner to hold the short sword and make the first thrusts and parries without any qi.

title: Handbook of Close Blade Drill
summary: A drill handbook of short thrusts and checks for a recruit whose skin has hardened to the first blows.

title: First Lessons in the Short Edge
summary: Gives muscle-stage students a graded set of guards and steps for fighting inside the length of a forearm.

title: The Stabbing Blade Workbook
summary: A workbook of repeated stabbing forms that builds tendon strength and wrist control for the short blade.

title: Plain Guide to Short Blade Footing
summary: A footwork-first guide for bone-stage students who must close distance and stay inside an opponent's reach.

title: Drill-Book of the Hand-Length Sword
summary: A drill-book of paired exercises where two students trade thrusts and parries at a slow measured pace.

title: Short Blade Fundamentals for the Awakened
summary: Shows a newly awakened student how to let a thin thread of qi follow the short blade through its thrusts.

title: Treatise on the Belt-Blade and Its Draw
summary: A treatise on drawing the belt-worn short sword and striking in the same breath with light qi support.

title: Workbook of the Close Guard
summary: A workbook for circulating students on holding a tight guard and answering each parry with a short stab.

title: Elements of the Short Sword Thrust
summary: Breaks the thrust into grip and hip and breath and shows how qi sharpens the point at the last instant.

title: Common Canon of the Short Edge
summary: The widely copied canon of basic short sword work for any student who can circulate qi and hold a blade.

title: Short Sword Lessons for the Circulating Student
summary: Sets out six graded lessons that pair steady footwork with qi-backed stabs for students new to circulation.
